description: Compilers, test runners, and linters. Safe to allow broadly even though e.g. `node -e "..."` / `python -c "..."` can run arbitrary interpreted code we can't statically inspect: unlike the dev-server/playwright/container category, these run as ONE self-contained Bash call, so the kernel sandbox (bubblewrap) stays ON and enforces filesystem/network containment on whatever the interpreter actually does, regardless of what this argv-level rule can see. See docs/SANDBOX-FINDINGS.md.
